description: Start an async parse of an .xlsx workbook (or a .csv/.tsv file) and return at once with a job handle {job_id, status: "processing", status_url, stream_url}. Use it instead of parse_workbook for large files or when you don't want to wait: call stream_job with wait_seconds to wait for the records (or status_only to just check). Every call starts a new job and counts against the API key's parse quota, so don't resubmit a file whose job is still running. Pass exactly one of path, url or base64 (up to 20 MB); the file is uploaded to the Basis API. webhook_url, if set, gets an HMAC-signed POST when the job finishes, so you can skip polling.

path.description: Local filesystem path to an .xlsx or .csv file (read on this machine, then uploaded)

url.description: URL to fetch the .xlsx or .csv file from

webhook_url.description: https URL that gets an HMAC-signed POST with the job's status when the parse finishes

name: submit_job
title: Submit parse job
